subject.title: Org claim: vmware-aiops + vmware-monitor — @kingaiwork lookalikes impersonate @zw008 listings (same pattern as #2966/#3035)

question: Should the production repair retain the removed listings as soft-deleted moderation records and fix active-skill lookup semantics, or is an admin-authorized hard deletion required for these specific records?
rationale: The visible state indicates public removal did not necessarily reconcile every registry record, while repository policy treats hard deletion and moderation evidence as security-sensitive lifecycle decisions.

options.title: Audit and repair active lookup semantics
options.body: Keep the removed records only if required for moderation history, ensure scan/listing queries exclude inactive rows, and repair the two affected publisher versions.

options.title: Hard-delete the two orphaned rows
options.body: Use the admin-only deletion path only after confirming no audit, appeal, restore, or retention obligation requires the rows to remain.

recommendation.title: Audit and repair active lookup semantics
recommendation.body: Keep the removed records only if required for moderation history, ensure scan/listing queries exclude inactive rows, and repair the two affected publisher versions.

likelyOwner.reason: Their credited work on the current soft-delete ban flow is the closest available history signal for this lifecycle decision.
